goal: 3 native virtual subexecutors + NOX itself share 30 bounded tasks; no new workers, trainer, backend, S03 or chat
security: Data-only plan. Native queue accepts only reviewed typed handler intents; never execute task text as code. Do not auto-register all 30 or create 30 OS processes. No deletion of unique models/checkpoints/S03/GENESIS. Old unused artifacts only after independent restore and referenced path check.
next_steps: Do not pretend source file is native queue
Review mapping to existing queue handlers and signed owner native API
Enqueue at most 3 safe tasks after STOP+lease+readback
Record one unique job_id and S03 receipt per task; leave unadmitted tasks PREPARED_NOT_NATIVE_ENQUEUED
